test_title: PYST 72: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Out of the following four figures, three are alike in some manner, and one differs from these in that manner. Select the ODD figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0009158aeabb39de55df7eca1cffff07664f878605187bbe7822fe6053e9bd14.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** The relationship is based on the correspondence between the number of sides of the outer figure and the number of internal smaller shapes. In most figures, the number of internal shapes is equal to the number of sides of the outer polygon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0009158aeabb39de55df7eca1cffff07664f878605187bbe7822fe6053e9bd14.png] 

Now, checking the Options:

**Option 1:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb69e77e36b4abf875441e7cceebf3b3b625afb2ef7d47a23d1e6a81c47b39ad.png] 

Triangle → 3 sides, 3 internal shapes → Follows the rule

Option** 2:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e8191830e4c7d75d5315dd4cf0dec5b5a3eeac9f59f34e83eb7fceedd24533e.png] 

Hexagon → 6 sides, 6 internal shapes → Follows the rule

Option 3: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68485e5a212fe362507e79b0d0e0ad88144eeeac52317176e4128b7911b68bd3.png] 
Four-pointed star → 8 sides, but only 4 internal shapes → Breaks the rule → Odd one out

Option** 4:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/976b170695b5fb5add185e9529d5bbdc19e7c6381dd803bc9a915b098a1241d3.png] 

Rectangle → 4 sides, 4 internal shapes → Follows the rule

Hence, Option 3 is the odd figure out.
